subQuests.subQuestName: Take part in the post-battle banquet

50140101.text: Everyone, we are gathered here to celebrate a glorious victory.

50140102.text: It is a victory forged by each and every one of us, and we should all be proud of what we have accomplished.

50140103.text: We emerge victorious from another crisis to declare: Our beloved Natlan is saved!

50140105.text: I must caution that this war is not yet over. We have not destroyed our enemy, merely driven them further into the depths of the Night Kingdom.

50140106.text: But the Abyss underestimated Natlan's forces, and they have suffered a devastating defeat. It will be a long time before they are able to pose a threat to us again.

50140107.text: After making some preparations, I will launch my final counterattack. I shall strike them in their lair and wipe them out for good.

50140109.text: Wait, Archon... Are you saying you're going alone?

50140110.text: Yes. The Abyssal energy there is too strong. Contact with it would be instantly lethal to anyone else.

50140111.text: I'm sure you're all still fired up, and you must be eager to take the fight home to the enemy. But I must ask you to temper your ambitions. I will return victorious, for all of us.

50140112.text: It's kind of a shame that we can't join in with the final showdown...

50140113.text: Please, look at the bigger picture. Thanks to every one of you, we have already secured an enormous victory. Tonight, we should celebrate to our hearts' content.

50140114.text: I guess... if our lives are no longer at risk, things can basically go back to normal, right?

50140115.text: That's good enough for me. Beats having monsters everywhere.

50140116.text: When the time comes, I will gather everyone here again.

50140117.text: Now, let us also remember those who gave their lives fighting for our nation.

50140118.text: Once the last dregs of the Abyss are wiped out, I intend to give them the grand funeral they deserve.

50140119.text: An ancient name could never record the many who we lost, but no hero of Natlan should be forgotten.

50140120.text: If I may... Let's have a moment of silence for the fallen.

50140123.text: Lastly, there is one more person I must thank for his extraordinary support in our time of need, and that is The Captain.

50140124.text: Speaking in a personal capacity, I should like to offer my sincere congratulations on your victory.

50140125.text: Well everyone, please enjoy the victory feast. I hope it's a chance to relax your minds and rekindle your spirits, so that we may face what lies ahead with renewed vigor.

50140201.text: You did a great job, Kachina. You're much more confident now. Seems like winning the Pilgrimage gave you a real boost.

50140202.text: Hehe, nah, I just figured I should do my part, y'know?

50140203.text: I spoke to your mom and dad — they were singing your praises. They said the world's your oyster now.

50140204.text: How are things at the People of the Springs' base?

50140205.text: There are some casualties, but the overall mood is very positive. I reckon they'll start rebuilding pretty soon.

50140206.text: Same situation for the Children of Echoes.

50140207.text: Still... it's so sad that some people couldn't be saved by the Ode of Resurrection.

50140208.text: I think... I wanna hold a candlelight vigil for them when I get home.

50140209.text: Oh, that's a great idea. Let's do it together.

50140210.text: Let's hope that their sacrifice marks the beginning of a new age for Natlan — an age of unprecedented peace.

50140301.text: Kinich, you are one lucky devil. I don't know how the heck you're still alive. Pff.

50140302.text: I'm in a zero-tolerance mood right now. Stop being so flippant.

50140303.text: Unless you want to get punched in the face.

50140304.text: What is it with you, Ajaw? Why are you so incapable of being nice?

50140305.text: Oh, this is rich! One measly victory, and it's all gone to your head! Hmph, you'd all be mincemeat by now if not for the heroic deeds of the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw!

50140306.text: Alright, credit where credit's due. Here's a bunch of grapes for your trouble.

50140307.text: Don't treat me like I'm your pet parrot!

50140308.text: How are the Scions of the Canopy and the Collective of Plenty?

50140309.text: The messengers are the worst affected. I expect there'll be delays on all deliveries in Natlan for some time.

50140310.text: Although fortunately, a lot of people have said they're willing to help out part time. That should alleviate the situation.

50140311.text: The Collective of Plenty was the furthest from the Abyss's entry point, so they didn't have as many monsters to deal with. From what I hear, they got off relatively unscathed.

50140312.text: But it might have been a different story if Chasca hadn't gotten there when she did...

50140313.text: That's good to hear. All's well that ends well.

50140314.text: Well, whaddya know, these are pretty tasty... Oh, servant! One more bunch of grapes, posthaste!

50140401.text: I must congratulate you on your efforts during this war. I am told you have proven yourself to be an outstanding adventurer and warrior.

50140402.text: #You remind me of the {M#Princess}{F#Prince}. The similarities in your approach are striking, especially when you told me you wanted to win.

50140405.text: Hey, Ororon, how are the Masters of the Night-Wind doing?

50140406.text: Granny Citlali's been there the whole time, and she's a tough one. I think we should be fine...

50140407.text: I'm sure there'll be some patching up to do though. That's a job for the young folks — I should probably head back, so I can pitch in.

50140408.text: Do you need support from the Fatui?

50140409.text: ...Probably not. There are a lot of older folks in our tribe, and I suspect they would find your comrades' presence a little distressing.

50140410.text: Right, 'cause they often look like a bunch of intimidating thugs.

50140411.text: Well, also, in my tribe, excessive use of elemental energy is bad for your eyesight.

50140702.text: You seem a little out of sorts. Are you just tired, or...?

50140703.text: I guess I am. You know, when I was up there in the sky, I could see all of Natlan stretching out below me... People everywhere, giving everything they had for a chance at victory.

50140704.text: I just... If only I'd been quicker, maybe they wouldn't have... And Chuychu, maybe she'd still...

50140705.text: ...I'm sorry, now's not the time for that. Um... Fruit juice, right?

50140707.text: At least it's over now. That's something.

50140708.text: True. My 500-year plan has almost come to fruition. Just one last step to go.

50140709.text: Namely, my final battle against the Abyss. But battle is second nature to me, so I'm not feeling a huge amount of pressure.

50140710.text: It was so awesome, the way you exploded that thing in the sky with one almighty punch! Are you always gonna have that kind of power from now on?

50140711.text: Oh, that was the divine throne unleashing my full potential, and it was only temporary. I can't wield that power for any length of time — my body wouldn't be able to handle it.

50140712.text: Likewise, the amplified power of the Ode of Resurrection was also temporary. From now on, it's back to ancient name bearers only.

50140713.text: I'm guessing the Night Warden Wars are over for the foreseeable future?

50140714.text: Correct. We dealt the Abyss a critical blow, so for the time being, it's too weak to sustain regular invasions.

50140715.text: I hope the people will be able to enjoy this period of peace... Or rather, assuming all goes to plan — eternal peace.

50140716.text: We've had centuries of war with the Abyss, and it's high time we brought that chapter to a close.

50140717.text: Anyway, there's something I've been wondering about. I know you've been at the center of some major events in other nations too, and fought many powerful foes.

50140718.text: In this war, you were in the thick of it once again. Dashing around tirelessly, supporting the fighting on all fronts... So tell me, what drives you to do this as a mere Traveler passing through? Why risk life and limb for a cause that's not your own?

50140720.text: A clear conscience... Great answer. That's how life should be lived: to the fullest, with no regrets.

50140726.text: What I'm really trying to say is... I would love for you, with your extraordinary talent and your sense of justice, to join me in this final step. You and I, together, finally putting an end to the ever-looming threat of the Abyss...

50140727.text: But I also don't want to take advantage of your good nature and readiness to help others. The final battle will be very dangerous, and you have the rest of your journey to consider.

50140728.text: I'm sure you must be weary? Sleep well tonight. Let's talk again tomorrow, in the Speaker's Chamber.

50140729.text: I'll give you more details on the final battle, and then I hope to hear your verdict.

50140722.text: You know, it's that mindset that distinguishes the heroes in every story. They're the natural protagonists.

50140724.text: ...What's this got to do with Paimon?

50140725.text: #Hahaha, {M#he's just showing how much you mean to him, in his own way.}{F#she's just showing how much you mean to her, in her own way.}

Go to the Speaker's Chamber to look for Mavuika

50141201.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}, Paimon. There you are, I've been looking all over for you.

50141203.text: Listen up. I have something really important to tell you...

50141204.text: Citlali quickly explains her concerns about Mavuika's death.

50141206.text: So Mavuika still has to die...

50141207.text: Natlan must pay the price for Mavuika's use of the Ruler of Death's power. That price is death, and only Mavuika's death can clear the debt.

50141208.text: I had thought that the Ruler of Death might have a change of heart after seeing the people of Natlan come together and fight so bravely. But...

50141209.text: Even now that the war's over and the threat to Natlan is gone, it looks like that death is still set in stone.

50141210.text: I had to know your thoughts — I want to save her, but I can't do it alone.

50141211.text: I'll see what I can do.

50141212.text: Okay, good. That makes me feel a little better.

50141213.text: Thank you for standing up for us. There's clearly something special about you, so if anyone has a chance of defying the rules, that would be you.

50141214.text: Oh, and please don't breathe a word of this to Mavuika.

50141215.text: I'm sure she's well aware of the cost of using the divine throne's power. But if she finds out that anyone else knows, it could ruin our chances to help.

50141217.text: Alright, that was the last major item on my to-do list. Now, since I've come all this way, I think it's finally time for a well-earned drink.

50141219.text: Don't worry, I said "a" drink. That means just one.

50140801.text: The outlander with deep ties to this land returns... and this time, he is alone?

50140802.text: The power that the Pyro Archon used to strike back at the Abyss came from the Ruler of Death. From what I know of her rules, she will demand death in return.

50140803.text: How do you know of this?

50140804.text: ...I see. So, the Ruler of Death sent you on your long journey.

50140805.text: Natlan still has a final battle to fight, and I too have a final foe to face.

50140806.text: For the sake of those countless lost souls, and a hope for Natlan's future... I need your help.

50142001.text: Alright, you little munchkin! If you keep pestering me, I'm gonna have to get serious.

50142002.text: I get a hundred kids a day telling me they want to be the next Pyro Archon. So, why should I train you?

50142003.text: *sigh* Nagging isn't going to accomplish anything. No one can predict the future, and unless you have some exceptional, jaw-dropping talent I'm unaware of—

50142004.text: "I can shoot those cornflakes in your kitchen from right here."

50142005.text: Hahaha, don't be ridiculous! You couldn't make that shot from all the way over here. ...Wait, hold on, you could hurt someone with that...

50142006.text: ...Well I'll be. You made the shot.

50142007.text: The Scions of the Canopy raise 'em tough... That's some real skill you've got there, little lady. Maybe you really will be Pyro Archon one day.

50142101.text: See this? I'm the first one of us to get an ancient name — and not just any ancient name, but Mal{RUBY#[D]Turnfire}ipo!

50142102.text: If you ask me nicely, there's still time to join my team for the Pilgrimage, y'know...

50142103.text: No need to scowl... You lost, and I won, it's no big deal. You want me to be happy for you when your turn comes, right? So cheer up.

50142104.text: "I'll get my own ancient name soon enough. And it'll be an even better one than yours."

50142105.text: Oh really? Well, good luck with that... What ancient name could beat Mal{RUBY#[D]Turnfire}ipo in our tribe?

50142106.text: Unless... Surely you don't mean Kion{RUBY#[D]Leader}gozi?

50142201.text: Ah, that was fantastic! I can't believe I beat you in a wrestling match for once.

50142202.text: Can't be more than a few days now until you're officially made the Pyro Archon. Heh, imagine me trying to schedule a wrestling session with you after that...

50142203.text: "Excuse me, Pyro Archon, but would you be able to take a day off from running the nation to wrestle with me?" Hahaha.

50142204.text: I heard that the Pyro Archon inherits the knowledge stored in the Sacred Flame, and apparently, it can change your personality... I can't help but feel a little worried.

50142205.text: "Worried that you won't be able to beat me in a wrestling match anymore?"

50142206.text: Why would I be worried about that!? Ugh, never mind, clearly I'm just overthinking things. Why would you forget about me just because of some new job? Even if that job happens to be archon.

50140901.text: The victors shall burn bright, while the losers must turn to ash...

50140902.text: I have done what is required of me. The rules are now written into the Night Kingdom, and this will help you to stand against the Abyss.

50140904.text: All this can do is give my people courage. It will not see us through a true catastrophe.

50140905.text: If you are to make the Natlanese alone bear the consequences of a broken world, you will have to bring more to the bargaining table.

50140906.text: ...You are the greediest human I have ever met, and the fiercest negotiator. No other would seriously ask to borrow my power.

50140907.text: My domain is death, and its power comes at a great price... The question is, are you prepared to pay?

50140908.text: I need that power. Only a hero can truly wield it, and heroes are not afraid of dying.

50140909.text: No, a fear of death is ingrained in all living things. If the wielder of this power cannot conquer their fear, countless innocent lives will be claimed in their stead, for only then can the price be paid.

50140911.text: Mine is a nation that will not yield to the Abyss. It will certainly not yield to your rules.

50140912.text: As their culture and civilization is transmitted through the generations, and their faith grows, the people will go from strength to strength, and reach heights that even I cannot dream of.

50140913.text: Very well. I shall agree to help you. But I am merely a Shade, and I do not have as much freedom to do as I please as you might think.

50140916.text: If I am questioned about it, I will deny all involvement, and claim: "That treacherous Xbalanque stole my power."

50140917.text: That will not be a problem. Thank you, I am glad we could reach an agreement.

50141002.text: As you know, I've asked you to come here to discuss the task of wiping out the Abyss.

50141003.text: Oh, but first — any progress on the Ancient Name?

50141004.text: I've received the gift from the Lord of the Night.

50141005.text: I'm surprised she was willing to help you... and, by extension, me. I'm very grateful to her.

50141006.text: #Wait, hold on, wasn't the whole point of the Ancient Names for winning that huge battle? Why would {NICKNAME} still need one by this point?

50141007.text: Because she wants me to join her in the final battle.

50141008.text: That's right. The Abyss has retreated to the depths of the Night Kingdom, a place that has long since been corrupted by Abyssal energy...

50141009.text: If we don't finish them off and restore the Ley Lines, the threat they pose to Natlan will remain. The battle we fought yesterday, we may one day have to fight again.

50141010.text: This is the fate Natlan has always been resigned to. For thousands of years, we have struggled on the brink of a looming darkness, and never known true peace.

50141011.text: But this time, I want to break the cycle and free us from this fate for good.

50141012.text: With the sacred flame, I can protect myself from the Abyssal corruption, but beyond that, you are the only other person who can resist it.

50141013.text: If your ancient name can't be forged, I will go alone. But if it can, I'd really love your help.

50141014.text: Is the Ode of Resurrection working again?

50141015.text: Not completely — after all, the Night Kingdom is still plagued by Abyssal corruption.

50141016.text: But when I used the power of the divine throne, it dispelled a lot of that corruption. Plus, your ancient name is a special case, so the Lord of the Night will take special care of you.

50141017.text: In short, the Ode of Resurrection still has a number of limitations, but I can promise that it will work reliably on you.

50141020.text: Whoa whoa whoa, aren't we forgetting something here? What about Paimon? What's her place in all this?

50141022.text: What!? You mean, we'll be separated?

50141023.text: The Abyss is extremely devious. If you two go there together, you can bet they'll make Paimon their primary target just to put us in an impossible position.

50141024.text: Paimon wasn't that worried, but... now she's petrified...

50141025.text: What will you do without me!?

50145001.text: If you're making candles, I have some materials you can use. They're in the warehouse. Should have plenty to spare.

50145002.text: Oh, okay! Um, I guess I'll... tread carefully on the way in, then? Or...

50145003.text: Oh, good point. I'll go instead.

50145101.text: Everyone else is enjoying the celebration, but Ajaw's still being as aggravating as ever. Does he have a chip on his shoulder? What's it about?

50145102.text: In fairness, repeating a few set phrases ad nauseum is all parrots know how to do.

50145103.text: I am NOT a parrot! I am the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw!

50145201.text: I am still somewhat in disbelief that a united people prevailed against the Abyss...

50145202.text: Do I sense some regret in your words?

50145203.text: A degree of regret is inevitable. But above all, I feel profound admiration.

50145301.text: My mind is still flooded with scenes from the war. I can't get the images out of my head...

50149901.text: Mavuika said she had more to discuss with us today. Let's head to the Speaker's Chamber.
